lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: Then I will sign it. God help me, I will sign it.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: A sensible house. Meridian will have the surveyors up by Thursday.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: My order will be a tenant of Meridian for three centuries and never once write that down. I did not know.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vance closes her case. Behind her, something tall unfolds itself off the transport and starts up the path.
